Vācaspati_Miśra_II
or ºŚarman. 15th cent. a prolific writer on Dharmaśāstra an. Navyanyāya, son of Keśava of Upamanyu gotra, father of Lakṣmīdāsa (a. of C. on Siddhāntaśiromaṇi, RORI. IX. 1757, Extr. p.. 255-56) an. preceptor of Vardhamānopādhyāya (a. of Daṇḍaviveka, IO. 1486). Court Paṇḍit of King Harinārāyaṇa alias Bhairavasiṃhadeva an. his son Rāma-bhadra of Mithilā. Vācaspati Miśra has attributed some of his works (Kṛtyamahārṇava, Vyavahāracintāmaṇi an. Mahādānanirṇaya) to his patron Bhairavendra, by the order of Jayā, Queen of Bhairavendra. He wrote Pitṛbhaktitaraṅgiṇī, in the reign of King Rāmabhadra.
He mentions in his Pitṛbhaktitaraṅgiṇī, that he wrote ten works on Śāstra an. thirty works on Smṛti. [Page44a]
For a. account of the a. see JASB (NS) XI (1915) p.. 270-71; 394-400. For Navya Nyāya works of the a. see D. C. Bhattacarya, J. of the G. Jha R. I. IV. pts. III-IV 1947, p.. 295-312.
See D. C. Bhattacarya, His.. of Navya Ny. in Mithila, p.. 153-58; also see Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 844ff.
Q. in Vidyākarasahasraka, Intro. p.. 13-14, verse 486; to know about the a. see Intro. to Vivādacintāmaṇi, GOS.
On his indebtedness to Lakṣmīdhara Bhaṭṭa, see NIA. IX. p. 100.
